items.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
items.feed_excerpt: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.

items.title: From 8VC to Benchmark, here’s what’s hiding in October SEC filings
items.feed_excerpt: A whole crop of venture capital firms are raising significant new funds.

items.title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more

items.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
items.feed_excerpt: A new developer platform will let businesses bring their services to Google's AI experiences, potentially changing how consumers discover and use apps.

items.title: AI execs may be too out of touch to build for the general public
items.feed_excerpt: Tech leaders are flaunting how out of touch they are when they brag about using AI to connect with their families.

items.title: Trump DOE loans $5B to nuclear plants that will power data centers
items.feed_excerpt: Constellation Energy will get $5 billion in government loans to modernize nuclear reactors. Most of the new capacity is already committed to Google, Amazon, and Meta.

items.title: Amazon debuts the Alexa Photo Frame and Echo Time smart clock, plus other upgraded devices
items.feed_excerpt: Amazon's other new devices include an upgraded Echo Dot, an Echo Studio with visual intelligence features, and the Echo Show 16.

items.title: TikTok expands into restaurant guides with ‘Must Eat’ feature
items.feed_excerpt: The move puts TikTok in more direct competition with platforms like Yelp and Google.

items.title: Meta has a new AI pet app called Waddle World
items.feed_excerpt: Meta launched a new app called Waddle World, which essentially looks like a Tamagotchi clone, but with AI.

items.title: Free Fire returns to India as Garena launches localized version four years after ban
items.feed_excerpt: Free Fire India was originally set to launch in September 2023, but Garena postponed its release.

items.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
items.feed_excerpt: The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.

items.title: Apple’s touchscreen MacBook Pro pushes laptop pricing to a new extreme
items.feed_excerpt: Prepare to cough up around $14,549 if you want the new touchscreen MacBook Pro to have every upgrade.

items.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
items.feed_excerpt: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

items.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
items.feed_excerpt: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

items.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
items.feed_excerpt: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.

items.title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row
items.feed_excerpt: Whatever the future of AI might be, the current situation is still very good for Microsoft. The tech giant reported yet another record for quarterly revenue on Wednesday: $92.3 billion, a 19% increase over the year-ago quarter.

items.title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents
items.feed_excerpt: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.

items.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
items.feed_excerpt: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.

items.title: U.S. investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
items.feed_excerpt: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

items.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
items.feed_excerpt: rained on 100 million square feet of building permits, dream wants to disrupt Autodesk with AI.

items.title: SuperMe raises $20M for its network of AI expert profiles
items.feed_excerpt: SuperMe just raised $20 million to let you pester AI clones of Silicon Valley’s savviest people about your career.

items.title: Agent identity startup Mintive lands Cowboy Ventures, Coatue, angels Jeff Dean, Andrej Karpathy
items.feed_excerpt: Mintive was founded by two engineers who have been working on AI for decades through Google Brain and Coursera. It's platform promises to help IT easily control enterprise agents.

items.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, now valued at $1.25B after latest round
items.feed_excerpt: On Thursday, AI app Wabi, now describing itself as a "personal agent," said it has raised $55 million at a $1.25 billion valuation.

items.title: Bluesky blocks links to leaked DHS employee data as government seeks takedowns
items.feed_excerpt: The social networking site is facing criticism for blocking access to the site, which identifies thousands of ICE agents and other employees working for Homeland Security.

items.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17B
items.feed_excerpt: The acquisition would bring two major players in on-demand delivery under one roof, combining DoorDash’s dominance in restaurant takeout with Instacart’s reach in grocery delivery.

items.title: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
items.feed_excerpt: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.

items.title: Amazon updates Alexa to help you manage shopping lists and subscriptions and update delivery instructions
items.feed_excerpt: The update allows you to use Alexa to create lists, register them, see what's on them, and add or edit items. You can also manage subscriptions.

items.title: Who will you learn from in 6 days at TechCrunch Founder Summit? Meet the founders and investors taking the stages
items.feed_excerpt: Six days from now, on November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit brings experienced founders, investors, and operators to Boston to share the decisions, mistakes, pivots, and lessons that shaped their companies. Register before it starts for ticket savings and deals.

items.title: Amazon reported booming cloud revenue but otherwise missed expectations
items.feed_excerpt: The biggest ouch of the report was its negative free cash flow of $2.4 billion.

items.title: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers’ private data
items.feed_excerpt: As part of the settlement, GM must get drivers’ express consent before it collects or shares their driving and location data.

items.title: Fan fiction site Archive of Our Own could be offline for up to 4 weeks
items.feed_excerpt: Archive of Our Own, the popular online home of fan fiction readers and writers, has bad news for its community.

items.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.feed_excerpt: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

items.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
items.feed_excerpt: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.

items.title: The R2 SUV is already Rivian’s best-selling vehicle
items.feed_excerpt: Rivian is seeing strong enough sales of the new EV that it improved its guidance to Wall Street for the second time this year.

items.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT

items.title: Where was my invite to the — wait, what? Airbnb had a gala?
items.feed_excerpt: Airbnb’s nonprofit held its inaugural gala on Wednesday in Los Angeles, and the internet had one reaction — the *what* gala?

items.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch
items.feed_excerpt: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

items.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
items.feed_excerpt: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

items.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
